changelog:
- Initial release of Property Graph Schema Designer.
- Converts domain descriptions and requirements into Neo4j-style graph schemas.
- Outputs node labels, relationship types, properties, constraints, index recommendations, and Cypher templates.
- Supports input from domain documentation, ER diagrams, relational schemas, or API schemas.
- Provides step-by-step modeling guidance and best practices for property graph schema design.
